queries.q0: are you sending me my card?
queries.q1: I did a money transfer to my account and it is not showing there.
queries.q2: I tried to make a transfer like five different times. Why won't your system let me? Is it broke?
queries.q3: I completed I transfer the day before yesterday in this country. The transfer still is not complete. I've checked on the account number multiple times to make sure that it is the right one. Can you check to see what's going on with this?
queries.q4: How do I know where the funds come from?
queries.q5: is my pin the same as my passcode
queries.q6: I'm worried my card might be lost in the mail? How long does it usually take to arrive?
queries.q7: Why am I charged a fee for getting cash?
queries.q8: Can I revive a physical card.
queries.q9: How can I request cash back? The ATM just gave me a different amount than what I've been charged though...

criteria.delivery: Ordering or obtaining a physical bank card, spare physical cards, card shipping, delivery status, tracking or delivery time estimates. NOT card activation, linking, replacement after loss, or expiry.

criteria.cash: ATM use or CASH WITHDRAWALS: availability, declines, pending status, withdrawal fees, unrecognized withdrawals, wrong cash amount or exchange rate, or a card swallowed by an ATM. Also depositing cash or cheques and their balance updates. NOT card payments or bank transfers.
